actions.convert_quote_to_invoice.descrip: Turn a customer-accepted quote into a real invoice. The new invoice copies the customer, line items, and totals from the quote.
actions.convert_quote_to_invoice.props.i: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.convert_quote_to_invoice.props.q: Pick the quote you want to convert into an invoice.
actions.create_bill.description: Record a bill you received from a supplier (e.g. a vendor invoice you need to pay).
actions.create_bill.props.bill_date.desc: The date printed on the supplier's bill.
The date you need to pay this bill by.
actions.create_bill.props.bill_number.de: The invoice number printed on the supplier's bill (so you can match it later). Must be unique per supplier in your Wafeq org.
actions.create_bill.props.contact.descri: Who sent you this bill? Pick from your Wafeq contacts.
actions.create_bill.props.currency.descr: Which currency the amounts below are in. Pick AED for UAE, SAR for Saudi Arabia, or any other currency you invoice in.
actions.create_bill.props.default_accoun: Where this cost is booked in your books (e.g. "Office Supplies", "Software Subscriptions"). Applied to every line item unless you override it on a specific line.
actions.create_bill.props.default_tax_ra: Tax applied to every line by default (e.g. "VAT 15% on purchases"). Leave blank if no tax.
actions.create_bill.props.external_id.de: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.create_bill.props.idempotency_ke: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_bill.props.line_items.des: Add one row for each product or service on the document. Each row needs at least a description, quantity, and unit price. Leave the account and tax fields blank to use the defaults you set above.
actions.create_bill.props.notes.descript: Optional notes visible in Wafeq. Not printed on anything and not shared with the supplier.
actions.create_bill.props.order_number.d: Optional. The purchase order number from your own system, if you issued one.
actions.create_bill.props.prices_include: If the supplier's prices already include tax, pick "Yes". If tax should be added on top, pick "No".
Do the prices above include tax?
No — add tax on top of the prices
actions.create_bill.props.reference.desc: Optional free text (e.g. project name, department).
actions.create_bill.props.status.descrip: Draft = still editable, not in your books yet. Authorized = approved and posted to your books. Start with Draft if unsure.
actions.create_contact.description: Add a new customer or supplier to your Wafeq address book so you can invoice them or record bills from them.
actions.create_contact.props.address.des: Street / building address. This appears on printed invoices.
actions.create_contact.props.country.des: Two-letter ISO country code: AE = UAE, SA = Saudi Arabia, US = United States, GB = UK, etc.
actions.create_contact.props.email.descr: Where to send invoices and other documents. Optional but recommended — Wafeq can email invoices directly.
actions.create_contact.props.external_id: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.create_contact.props.idempotency: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_contact.props.name.descri: The business name (for companies) or full name (for individuals). This is what appears on invoices and bills.
actions.create_contact.props.postal_code: The postal code. Must be exactly 5 digits for Saudi Arabia addresses.
actions.create_contact.props.relationshi: Pick "Customer" if you sell to them, "Supplier" if you buy from them, or both if they're on both sides.
actions.create_contact.props.tax_registr: The contact's VAT registration number (also called TRN in UAE, TIN in some countries). Required for tax-compliant B2B invoices — leave blank for individuals.
actions.create_credit_note.description: Issue a credit note to a customer — used when you refund them, correct an overcharge, or take back goods. A credit note reduces how much the customer owes you.
actions.create_credit_note.props.contact: Which customer is the credit note for?
actions.create_credit_note.props.credit_: The date shown on the credit note. Usually today.
A unique number for this credit note (e.g. CN-2024-001).
actions.create_credit_note.props.currenc: Which currency the amounts below are in. Pick AED for UAE, SAR for Saudi Arabia, or any other currency you invoice in.
actions.create_credit_note.props.default: The sales account the credit reverses against (usually the same account the original invoice posted to). Applied to every line unless overridden per line.
Tax applied to every line by default. Leave blank for no tax.
actions.create_credit_note.props.externa: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.create_credit_note.props.idempot: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_credit_note.props.line_it: Add one row for each product or service on the document. Each row needs at least a description, quantity, and unit price. Leave the account and tax fields blank to use the defaults you set above.
actions.create_credit_note.props.notes.d: Optional notes printed on the credit note (e.g. reason for the credit).
actions.create_credit_note.props.prices_: Do the prices above include tax?
No — add tax on top of the prices
actions.create_credit_note.props.referen: Optional text shown on the credit note (e.g. the original invoice number this refunds).
Draft = still editable. Sent = marked as sent to the customer. Finalized = locked and posted to your books.
actions.create_invoice.description: Create a new sales invoice for a customer.
actions.create_invoice.props.contact.des: Who are you billing? Pick from your Wafeq contacts.
actions.create_invoice.props.currency.de: Which currency the amounts below are in. Pick AED for UAE, SAR for Saudi Arabia, or any other currency you invoice in.
actions.create_invoice.props.default_acc: Where the money from this invoice is booked (e.g. "Sales Revenue"). This is applied to every line item unless you override it on a specific line.
actions.create_invoice.props.default_tax: Tax applied to every line by default (e.g. "VAT 15%"). Leave blank if this invoice has no tax.
actions.create_invoice.props.external_id: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.create_invoice.props.idempotency: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_invoice.props.invoice_dat: The date shown on the invoice. Usually today.
actions.create_invoice.props.invoice_due: The date you expect to be paid by.
actions.create_invoice.props.invoice_num: A unique number for this invoice (e.g. INV-2024-001). If you reuse a number, Wafeq will reject the invoice.
actions.create_invoice.props.language.de: Language used on the PDF invoice sent to the customer.
Add one row for each product or service on the document. Each row needs at least a description, quantity, and unit price. Leave the account and tax fields blank to use the defaults you set above.
actions.create_invoice.props.notes.descr: Optional notes printed at the bottom of the invoice (e.g. payment instructions, thank-you note).
actions.create_invoice.props.prices_incl: If you already baked tax into the unit prices, pick "Yes". If tax should be added on top of the prices, pick "No". Most B2B invoices use "No".
Do the prices above include tax?
No — add tax on top of the prices
actions.create_invoice.props.reference.d: Optional text printed on the invoice (e.g. a project name or the customer's PO number).
actions.create_invoice.props.status.desc: Draft = still editable, not posted to your books yet. Sent = emailed to the customer. Finalized = locked and posted to your books. Start with Draft if unsure.
actions.create_item.description: Add a product or service to your Wafeq catalog. Catalog items can be quickly added to invoices, bills, and quotes without retyping descriptions or prices.
actions.create_item.props.description.de: Optional longer description used as the default line text when this item is added to an invoice.
actions.create_item.props.expense_accoun: Advanced. The account ID purchases of this item post to.
actions.create_item.props.external_id.de: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.create_item.props.idempotency_ke: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_item.props.is_active.desc: Active items can be added to new invoices. Turn off to hide the item from pickers without deleting it.
actions.create_item.props.is_tracked_inv: Turn on for physical products where you want Wafeq to track inventory counts. Leave off for services and digital products.
actions.create_item.props.name.descripti: What the product or service is called (e.g. "Pro subscription", "Consulting hour"). This shows up in item pickers.
actions.create_item.props.purchase_tax_r: Advanced. Tax rate ID applied when buying this item.
actions.create_item.props.revenue_accoun: Advanced. The account ID sales of this item post to (e.g. "Sales Revenue"). Leave blank to use your org default.
actions.create_item.props.revenue_tax_ra: Advanced. Tax rate ID applied when selling this item. Leave blank for no default tax.
actions.create_item.props.sku.descriptio: Optional short code (e.g. "SUB-PRO-YR"). Useful if you also track the item in another system.
actions.create_item.props.unit_cost.desc: How much you pay suppliers per unit. Used as the default on bills.
actions.create_item.props.unit_price.des: How much you charge customers per unit. Used as the default on invoices and quotes.

actions.create_quote.props.default_accou: Where the revenue is booked when this quote becomes an invoice. Applied to every line unless overridden per line.
actions.create_quote.props.default_tax_r: Tax applied to every line by default. Leave blank for no tax.
actions.create_quote.props.external_id.d: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.create_quote.props.idempotency_k: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.create_quote.props.language.desc: Language used on the quote PDF.
actions.create_quote.props.line_items.de: Add one row for each product or service on the document. Each row needs at least a description, quantity, and unit price. Leave the account and tax fields blank to use the defaults you set above.
actions.create_quote.props.notes.descrip: Optional notes printed at the bottom of the quote.
actions.create_quote.props.prices_includ: Pick "Yes" if the prices already include tax, "No" if tax should be added on top.
Do the prices above include tax?
No — add tax on top of the prices
actions.create_quote.props.purchase_orde: Optional. If the customer sent you a purchase order number, enter it here so it appears on the quote.
actions.create_quote.props.quote_date.de: The date shown on the quote. Usually today.

actions.create_quote.props.reference.des: Optional free text shown on the quote (e.g. project name).
actions.create_quote.props.status.descri: Draft = still editable. Sent = marked as sent to the customer. Start with Draft if unsure.

actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.download_invoice_pdf.description: Download an invoice as a PDF. You can attach the file to a Gmail / Outlook email, save it to Google Drive or Dropbox, or upload it anywhere else in the flow.
actions.download_invoice_pdf.props.file_: What to call the downloaded PDF. Leave blank to use "invoice-<id>.pdf". The ".pdf" extension is added automatically if you don't include it.
actions.find_contact.description: Search your Wafeq contacts by name, email, phone, or tax number. Useful for checking if a customer already exists before creating a new one.
actions.find_contact.props.external_id.d: If you stored a reference ID when creating the contact (e.g. your CRM's customer ID), enter it here for an exact match.
actions.find_contact.props.keyword.descr: Type what you're looking for — part of a name, email, phone number, or tax number works. Leave blank to list all contacts.
actions.find_contact.props.limit.descrip: How many contacts to return at most. Default is 50, maximum is 200.
Only show customers, only suppliers, or both.
actions.list_accounts.description: List accounts from your Wafeq chart of accounts. Useful for exporting your chart of accounts or finding account IDs you need elsewhere.
actions.list_accounts.props.classificati: Filter to one kind of account. Revenue = sales accounts, Expense = cost accounts, Asset = bank / inventory, Liability = loans / payables, Equity = owner's capital.
Return the single account matching this reference ID (if you've stored one).
actions.list_accounts.props.is_payment_e: Payment-enabled accounts are the bank, cash, or card accounts you can receive or send money from.
actions.list_accounts.props.limit.descri: How many accounts to return at most. Default is 100, maximum is 500.
actions.list_items.description: List products and services from your Wafeq catalog. Useful for syncing your catalog to a spreadsheet or another system.
actions.list_items.props.created_after.d: Only return items created on or after this date.
Only return items created on or before this date.
actions.list_items.props.external_id.des: Find a single item by the reference ID you stored when creating it (e.g. your Shopify product ID).
actions.list_items.props.limit.descripti: How many items to return at most. Default is 50, maximum is 200.
actions.record_payment.description: Record money received from a customer (paying an invoice) or money sent to a supplier (paying a bill).
actions.record_payment.props.amount.desc: The full amount of the payment, including any fees. For a simple single-document payment, this should match the unpaid balance.
actions.record_payment.props.amount_to_p: The amount in the payment currency. Must be greater than zero.
actions.record_payment.props.contact.des: Optional. The customer or supplier this payment is with. Usually auto-detected from the document.
actions.record_payment.props.currency.de: Which currency the amounts below are in. Pick AED for UAE, SAR for Saudi Arabia, or any other currency you invoice in.
actions.record_payment.props.date.descri: When the payment was made or received. Use the date on your bank statement.
actions.record_payment.props.external_id: Optional. Store an ID from another system here (e.g. the order number from your online store) so you can find this record in Wafeq later.
actions.record_payment.props.idempotency: Advanced. If the flow retries this step, sending the same key prevents creating a duplicate. Most users can leave this blank.
actions.record_payment.props.paid_throug: Which bank, cash, or card account the money moved through. Only payment-enabled accounts are shown.
actions.record_payment.props.payment_fee: Optional. Any bank or card processing fees deducted from the payment (e.g. Stripe fee). Leave blank if none.

actions.record_payment.props.reference.d: Optional. A bank transaction ID or any note you want to attach.

auth.description:
**How to get your Wafeq API Key:**

1. Log in to your [Wafeq account](https://app.wafeq.com/accounts/signup/).
2. In the left-side menu, open the **Developer** section and click **API Keys**.
3. Click **Create new key** and copy the key — you won't be able to see it again.
4. Click **Enable API**. The API is available on the **Starter plan** or higher (including free trials).
5. Paste the key below.
description: Cloud accounting software for invoicing, bills, expenses, and tax reporting (ZATCA, UAE FTA).
triggers.new_bill.description: Fires when a new bill from a supplier is created. Useful for approval workflows — e.g. post the new bill to a Slack channel for a manager to authorize.
triggers.new_contact.description: Fires every time a new customer or supplier is added to your Wafeq address book. Useful for syncing new customers to HubSpot, Mailchimp, or your CRM.
Only fire on new customers, only suppliers, or both.
triggers.new_invoice.description: Fires every time a new invoice is created in Wafeq. Useful for logging sales to a spreadsheet, posting to Slack, or syncing to another system.
triggers.new_payment_received.descriptio: Fires every time a payment is recorded in Wafeq. Great for celebrating revenue in Slack, triggering commission calculations, or sending the customer a receipt.
